risks.risk: Camera may not power on or shutter may be faulty
risks.proof: A photo/video of the camera powered on with lens attached, showing live view or a test shot, plus shutter count via a tool like Nikon shutter count checker.

risks.risk: Sensor could have dust, scratches, or fungus affecting image quality
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the sensor with mirror locked up, or a sample test image showing even exposure.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming sensor condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: No lens included despite being a common bundle expectation
risks.proof: Photo showing a lens attached or included in the sale bundle.

risks.risk: Battery and charger claimed but not shown; battery health unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the actual battery and charger included, plus a photo of battery health/cycle count if accessible via camera menu.

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown, which heavily affects DSLR value
risks.proof: A screenshot of shutter count from firmware/EXIF data of a test shot.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a sample photo with a lens attached.
Photo of the shutter count (via EXIF data of a test image or on-screen menu).
Photo of the actual battery, charger, and any other included accessories.
Clear close-up of the sensor for dust/scratch/fungus check.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Nikon D610 body from the visible nameplate, but no lens or accessories are shown, functionality is unverified, and cosmetic wear is confirmed, so it must be priced at worst case as a body-only unit with unproven condition.
